Module com.example.cab302project
Package com.example.cab302project.Rewards

Class GardenGeometry

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302project.Rewards.GardenGeometry
public final class GardenGeometry extends Object
The garden's maths with no JavaFX in it, so it can be unit tested.

Everything is in the garden's own fixed 740 x 340 space. GardenPane draws at these numbers and scales the whole drawing to fit its card.

Stems and roots are scaled against each day's own goal, so the goal lines stay put even if a user's goals change from one day to the next.
